decision: The competitor (BWT Alpine F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: Car 10 was released into the path of Car 1.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly), and team representatives and reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence. The mechanic for Car 10 released the car into the path of Car 1 causing the driver of Car 1 to take significant evasive action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 10 Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
